column1: # Japanese (ja) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: menu and feature names follow the names Japanese users of vector illustration
# software know, written from the meaning of TerraZone's English labels; no other application's
# Japanese localisation was copied. Toggles read as their action (「…を表示」「…を隠す」).
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and every `tl!` literal (`complete_menus`,
# tested). Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name, language
# names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names.
# Panels, dialogs, tooltips, the hint bar and document tabs (from issue #217): written from the
# meaning of the English labels in the vocabulary Japanese users of vector illustration software know.
# Built at run time (status messages, counts, section lists).
# Strings added on main since the catalog was written (Layers panel, saved selections, Delete Anchor Points).
# The macOS menu bar (native_menu): the app and Window menus' system items, Settings pages.
# Photoshop-style raster effects (Effect menu, their dialogs).
